name: integer_division_truncation
description: Division uses Python's floor-division operator (//) instead of true division (/), a plausible slip when porting arithmetic logic from a language where '/' truncates. '7/2' returns 3.0 instead of 3.5. Everything else (precedence, associativity, unary minus, parentheses) is copied verbatim from the reference, isolating this single defect.
